SAMI BIN AYYAD GROUP – Algeria Apparel Market Study
Report code: SBA-GM-APP-DZA-001
Edition: 1.0
Date: 12 November 2026

Files
1) SBA_Algeria_Apparel_Market_Study.docx – Arabic market intelligence report.
2) SBA_Algeria_Apparel_Trade_Buyers_Compliance.xlsx – market indicators, Egypt export product mix, target buyer accounts, compliance, scenarios and sources.
3) This README.

Critical data notes
- Algeria apparel imports of USD 822m in 2024 are sourced from a specialist Africa apparel trade report. They are not retail sales.
- Qoovee's USD 1.7bn Apparel & Textile category is much broader than HS61+62 and includes textiles, fabrics and other chapters. Do not equate it with ready-made apparel imports.
- Egypt-reported exports to Algeria in 2025: HS61 USD 2.28m and HS62 USD 2.69m. These are not Algeria-reported imports and do not establish Egypt's market share.
- Detailed Algeria HS61+62 importer-reporter data by supplier, HS6/HS8 duties, and garment-specific landed costs remain to be verified.
- Bank domiciliation before shipment is a critical gate. Instruction 05-2026 adds financial standing requirements for importers of goods intended for resale as-is.
- Buyer accounts are prospects only. Validate CNRC registration, current activity, bank, financial standing, buying authority and recent imports.
- VAT standard rate is 19%; reduced rate 9% applies only to specified categories. Confirm product-specific treatment.
- The $6/pc scenario input is a placeholder only, not a market price or forecast.

SAMI BIN AYYAD GROUP
ANGOLA APPAREL MARKET STUDY PACKAGE
Issue date: 14 November 2026

CONTENTS
1) SBA_Angola_Apparel_Market_Study.docx
   Arabic extended report covering market structure, used clothing, local fashion brands,
   HS6 trade, buyer channels, tariff/VAT, REI, PICE, Documento Único, ADV, CNCA,
   logistics, SWOT and 180-day plan.

2) SBA_Angola_Trade_Buyers_Compliance.xlsx
   Executive Dashboard; HS6 Trade Data; Target Buyers & Brands; Tariff & Compliance;
   180-Day Entry Plan; Source Register.

IMPORTANT NOTES
- HS6 values are individual product lines, not total HS61+HS62 apparel imports.
- Egypt recorded USD780 in Angola's 2024 HS610910 imports.
- Used clothing HS630900 imports were USD34.118m in 2024 and are separate from new apparel.
- General import duty references range 2-50%; use the enacted 2026 tariff schedule for exact HS8/10.
- VAT standard rate is 14%.
- Confirm REI, PICE, Documento Único, ADV, CNCA and any product-specific import licence before shipment.
- Pre-shipment inspection is not generally mandatory under Decree 63/13, but verify exceptions and buyer/LC requirements.
- Target brands are partnership prospects, not confirmed importers or buyers.
- This is commercial research, not legal/customs advice.

Full source URLs and notes are included in the Word report and Excel Source Register.

محتويات الحزمة:

2) SBA_Canada_Apparel_Market_Data.xlsx – بيانات سوق، موردون، صادرات مصر، التعريفة، مستوردون محتملون، امتثال ومصادر.
3) README_Canada.txt – هذا الملف.

النطاق:
- الملابس الجديدة: HS61 وHS62.
- الملابس المستعملة: HS630900 في قسم منفصل.
- لا يتم استخدام HS392620 أو HS401590 بديلًا عن HS61+HS62.
- لا يتم جمع HS6 مختلفة في إجمالي سوق واحد.

ملاحظة التعريفة:
مصر مدرجة في قائمة CBSA كدولة مؤهلة عمومًا لـ GPT، لكن أهلية الدولة لا تعني أن كل بند ملابس يحصل على المعاملة التفضيلية. في التعريفة الكندية 2026، سطر HS6109.10 يظهر MFN 18% ولا يعرض GPT، وسطر HS6203.42 يظهر MFN 17% ولا يعرض GPT. يجب مراجعة tariff item الكامل وتحديثاته قبل الشحن.

قواعد GPT:
CBSA D11-4-4 (25 يونيو 2026) يشرح قواعد المنشأ والإثبات، بما في ذلك معيار 60% من سعر المصنع في مسار القيمة للسلع المؤهلة. يجب التحقق من أن السطر الجمركي يمنح GPT أولًا.

العملاء المحتملون:
الأسماء مأخوذة من Canadian Importers Database الحكومية ضمن HS610910 لعام 2024. الإدراج لا يثبت أن الشركة تبحث عن مورد أو أنها ستشتري من SBA.

حدود الدراسة:
لم يتم إدراج إجمالي تقديري لواردات HS61+HS62 بسبب عدم توفر استخراج موحد موثق ضمن المصادر المفتوحة المستخدمة. تم عرض بنود HS6 منفصلة بأرقامها.

EGYPT APPAREL MARKET STUDY PACKAGE
Version date: 14 November 2026

PACKAGE CONTENTS
1) SBA_Egypt_Apparel_Market_Study.docx
   Arabic market study covering industry, exports, domestic demand, competition,
   manufacturing clusters, product fit, target channels, trade agreements,
   customs/compliance, pricing, 180-day entry plan, risks and recommendations.

2) SBA_Egypt_Apparel_Market_Data.xlsx
   Structured workbook: Executive Dashboard; Exports & Trade; HS Product Strategy;
   Target Accounts; Competitive Landscape; Regulations & Origin; 180-Day Action Plan;
   Source Register.

METHODOLOGY & IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
- The 2024 and 2025 ready-made garment export figures are from the Apparel Export Council
  and GOEIC sources cited in the report.
- The broader 2025 textile/RMG trade total includes ready-made garments, spinning/weaving
  and furnishings. It must not be confused with ready-made garment exports alone.
- No unsupported aggregate value for Egyptian imports under all HS61+HS62 headings
  has been inserted. Product-level trade analysis must be completed from a consistent
  HS revision and reporter/partner dataset before making market-share claims.
- Target accounts are prospects or industry participants, not confirmed active buyers.
  Verify legal entity, current activity, sourcing route and procurement contact before outreach.
- Tariffs, origin rules, ACI/NAFEZA requirements, labeling and standards must be checked
  for the exact HS code, product composition, destination and shipment date.
- The study is commercial research, not legal, tax or customs advice.

CORE SOURCES
AECE, GOEIC, SIS, AmCham Egypt, Euromonitor, Egytex, ETDA, European Commission,
Textile Export Council, WTO, WITS/UN Comtrade and U.S. Department of Commerce.
Full URLs and source notes are included in the Word report and Excel Source Register.
